description: Reviewer role: your own per-hunk notes, mapped onto the hunk ids of the diff AS IT IS NOW. Call it when you draft the tour: the `what` bullets are already written, so grouping them by the author's plan is what is left. Also call it after head drift. Notes are keyed by hunk content rather than by id, so a commit that renumbers the diff keeps every note and this tells you the new id for each — `moved` lists the ones whose id changed, and `missing` the hunks still unnoted.
name: get_hunk_notes
